_readme: Settings for the Copilot test-generation workflow. Paths are relative to the repository root. See TESTGEN_README.md.

build._help: MSBuild is used when 'command' is empty. Building the .sln with /t:<TestProject> keeps the normal Visual Studio output folders ($(SolutionDir)x64\Debug).

tests._help: Google Test executables produced by the build. Several executables are allowed.

coverage._help: OpenCppCoverage needs a Debug build with PDB files. 'sources' limits measurement to your production code. tool='custom' lets you plug in another tool via customCommand (placeholders: {exe} {args} {output} {root}); it must write Cobertura XML to {output}.

paths._help: production = code under test (tests may not modify it). tests = where test code lives. testProjectFiles = project files the agent may edit to register new test .cpp files.
